note: Hand-picked recent AI reporting from large, reputable newsrooms, links verified. Source mix is limited by access tooling: WSJ, Reuters, FT and Bloomberg are blocked from automated browsing, so the openable/verified set skews CNBC, AP (wire) and MIT Technology Review. The updater (4×/day) can broaden sources over time.

items.title: AI groups spend $20 million in New York race shaping federal AI policy
items.blurb: AI-aligned PACs pour over $20M into a New York Democratic primary seen as a bellwether for U.S. AI regulation.

items.title: The $400 million machine powering the future of chipmaking
items.blurb: ASML's next-gen High-NA EUV lithography systems underpin the advanced chips that frontier AI training depends on.

items.title: Google takes the hit in AI's talent war
items.blurb: High-profile DeepMind and Gemini researchers leave for OpenAI and Anthropic, whose forthcoming IPOs sweeten recruiting.

items.title: SpaceX signs computing power deal with open-source AI startup Reflection worth up to $6.3 billion
items.blurb: Reflection AI to pay $150M/month from July for Nvidia GB300 capacity at SpaceX's Colossus 2, deepening the compute buildout.

items.title: Three things to watch amid Anthropic's latest feud with the government
items.blurb: Analysis of the escalating standoff after the US export order forced Anthropic to disable Fable 5 and Mythos 5 for foreign users.

items.title: Alphabet has its worst day in over a year on AI concerns after high-profile exits
items.blurb: Gemini co-lead Noam Shazeer departs for OpenAI and DeepMind's John Jumper for Anthropic, driving Alphabet's sharpest one-day drop in a year.

items.title: No one wants AI data centers on Earth. Do they make sense in space?
items.blurb: As land, power and water constraints bite, startups and hyperscalers weigh orbiting solar-powered AI data centers.

items.title: Do space-based AI data centers make economic sense?
items.blurb: With over 100 proposed local moratoriums on Earth, firms weigh orbital data centers as the compute buildout faces backlash.

items.title: Exclusive: Trump tells "The Axios Show" that Anthropic was a national security threat
items.blurb: Trump says Anthropic is no longer a threat "now," softening after a G7 meeting with Amodei; the Fable 5 export ban still stands.

items.title: John Jumper to leave Google DeepMind for Anthropic
items.blurb: AlphaFold creator and Nobel laureate John Jumper is departing Google DeepMind for Anthropic, escalating the labs' fight for elite AI talent.

items.title: A startup claims it broke through a bottleneck that's holding back LLMs
items.blurb: Miami startup Subquadratic claims to have solved a decade-old attention-scaling bottleneck that limits LLM context and cost.

items.title: Spatially interpretable AI framework tailors dual HER2 blockade in HER2-positive breast cancer
items.blurb: Interpretable AI model maps tumor tissue to personalize neoadjuvant dual-HER2 therapy, aiming to spare non-responders.

items.title: The Download: LLM bottleneck debates, and BCI trials take off
items.blurb: Researchers debate whether LLM scaling is hitting limits as brain-computer-interface clinical trials expand.

items.title: Google Gemini co-lead Noam Shazeer leaves for OpenAI
items.blurb: Transformer co-author and Gemini co-lead Noam Shazeer is joining OpenAI two years after Google paid ~$2.7B to rehire him.

items.title: Anthropic curbs ignite AI debate in India over sovereign AI
items.blurb: US export limits on Anthropic's models intensify India's push for sovereign AI, with local efforts called too slow and small.

items.title: Federal regulators back Trump's plan to speed power to energy-hungry AI data centers
items.blurb: FERC lets large energy users connect faster to the grid, easing buildout for surging AI compute demand.

items.title: Anthropic asked for regulation. Washington went much further
items.blurb: A White House export-control directive forced Anthropic to suspend its Fable 5 and Mythos 5 models — a contested, unprecedented intervention.

items.title: Bernie Sanders unveils plan for public ownership of AI companies
items.blurb: Sanders proposes a one-time 50% stock tax on the largest AI firms to seed a ~$7T public fund paying every American dividends.

items.title: AI in spotlight at G7 as Trump, world leaders joined by tech chiefs
items.blurb: Altman, Amodei and Hassabis joined G7 leaders in France; labs expect voluntary safety commitments to become the de facto global baseline.

items.title: AI protectionism opens a new front at the G7
items.blurb: European leaders press the US over the export-control order suspending Claude Fable 5/Mythos 5 as AI access dominates the G7 agenda.

items.title: Advancing conversational diagnostic AI with multimodal reasoning
items.blurb: Google's AMIE diagnostic AI matches or beats primary-care physicians on multimodal consultation quality in a Nature Medicine study.

items.title: CEOs of Anthropic and Google DeepMind call for U.S.-led AI coalition at G7
items.blurb: Amodei and Hassabis urged a U.S.-led alliance to set global AI standards in a G7 meeting with Trump and tech leaders.

items.title: Want to get a data center online quickly? Give it some flex
items.blurb: Software that throttles AI workloads during demand peaks could let data centers use existing grid capacity instead of new power plants.

items.title: The new oil? Inside the effort to turn AI computing power into a tradeable commodity
items.blurb: Startups and exchanges are trying to make GPU compute a tradeable commodity as data-center demand scales into gigawatts.
